}}'''Marthea''' was a [[Shaido]] [[Maiden of the Spear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Marthea}}

== Activities ==
She became [[Arrela Shiego]]'s protector while Arrela was a ''[[gai'shain]]'' in the town of [[Malden]]. They become lovers.<ref name="comparrela">[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Arrela Shiego.</ref> She hated what the Shaido did but stayed with them out of loyalty. Ultimately this cost her her life and she died in the [[Battle of Malden]].
